name: Vaultwarden
description: Vaultwarden is a lightweight password manager that works with Bitwarden apps. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Vaultwarden as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password manager. Deploy Vaultwarden with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
